annotations.label: T cells (subtype unresolved)
annotations.notes: Computed: CD3D (87% vs 25%), CD3E (78% vs 27%) and LDHB are enriched, along with ribosomal genes. The abstracts support CD3D/CD3E as T-cell genes, not LDHB. CD4, CD8, IL7R and CCR7 were not examined in this run, so no CD4/CD8 or naive/memory call. 848 cells.

annotations.label: CD14+ classical monocytes
annotations.notes: Computed: S100A8, S100A9, LGALS2, FCN1, CD14 (65% vs 3%) and LYZ are strongly enriched. The abstracts support CD14+ monocytes and S100A8/S100A9 in classical monocytes. They do not support LGALS2, FCN1 or LYZ. 313 of its 322 cells come from baseline cluster 1.

annotations.label: Cytotoxic lymphocytes (NK cells and CD8+ effector T cells, mixed)
annotations.notes: Computed: strong enrichment of GZMA, NKG7, CST7, PRF1 and CCL5, plus GZMH, FGFBP2, GZMB, GZMK and KLRD1. This cluster did not split into NK and T cells at this resolution. CD3D, CD8A and KLRF1 were not examined here. The abstracts support cytotoxic genes, not an NK versus CD8 T split.

annotations.label: B cells
annotations.notes: Computed: CD79A (94% vs 4%), MS4A1, CD79B, TCL1A, BANK1 and VPREB3 are enriched, with MHC class II genes. FCER2 and TCL1A suggest a naive-like subset (inference, not tested). PMID 38770541 names CD79A and MS4A1 as B-cell markers, but only in a CLL case. Distinct UMAP island.

annotations.label: FCGR3A+ (CD16+) non-classical monocytes
annotations.notes: Computed: FCGR3A (92% vs 14%), MS4A7, CDKN1C, LILRA3, LST1 and FCER1G are enriched. No cytotoxic genes appear among the top markers. The abstracts support FCGR3A+ monocytes only, not MS4A7, CDKN1C or LILRA3. CD14 was not checked in this run, so confidence stays tentative.

annotations.label: Dendritic cells (CD1C+ cDC-like; pDC admixture possible)
annotations.notes: Computed: FCER1A (86% vs 0.8%), CLEC10A, SERPINF1 and CD1C are enriched in only 29 cells. CLEC4C and FLT3 (17% each) suggest possible pDC admixture. Support is limited to a tumor scRNA abstract naming FCER1A+CD1C+ DCs and iPSC-derived CD1c+ cDC2 cells. Partial overlap, so tentative.
